note: Values printed by game-verify (the game's own readers, 0.304.7). old_segments.py reproduces every one of them without game code. Hashes cover blocks with type != 0, including blocks whose type the block config does not know (exit 1 marks those blueprints). Stock paths are relative to the game install ($STARMADE_DIR).

hash.rawHash: SHA-256 over blocks sorted by x,y,z: i32 x,y,z big-endian + 3 stored bytes (value little-endian)
hash.contentHash: SHA-256 over blocks sorted by x,y,z: i32 x,y,z + u16 type + u8 orientation + u8 active + u8 hp, big-endian
hash.linksHash: SHA-256 over (controller, type, target) sorted: i32 x,y,z + u16 type + i32 x,y,z, big-endian
